title: IT And Telecom Services
definition: The Information Technology (IT) and Telecommunications sector comprises software development, IT-enabled services (ITeS), business process management (BPM), and wired/wireless telecommunication infrastructure that acts as the digital backbone of India's modern service economy.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (Digital India, 5G spectrum, AGR, USOF, international tech pacts) and Mains GS-3 (Economy: growth drivers, employment, digital divide, infrastructure, inclusive growth).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of IT And Telecom Services.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Service Sector in Indian Economy
Basic understanding of national infrastructure and digital public goods
